scope: Randomized variants of nine Warrior requests with a prepull outside the plain rotation (validation/2026-10-06-warrior-prepull-sweep/*.base.json, built from the production Fury, Arms and Protection Warrior requests): a move to 25 yards with a change to Battle Stance and Charge, two moves, a late move that is still running at the pull, the Diamond Flask cast in the prepull, cast by the rotation and with a move and Charge, and a tank that Charges. Each base has 16 variants within melee range and 8 at any distance, at 200 iterations, with the race drawn from every race that can be a Warrior, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. The 18 rejected variants are the Windshaper Skyborne, whose Elemental Blessing multiplies the movement speed, which the gate refuses with a prepull move.
generator: python3 tools/sweep.py validation/2026-10-06-warrior-prepull-sweep/NAME.base.json --seed 20261006 --count 16 --iterations 200 --max-distance 5 --races RaceHuman,RaceOrc,RaceTroll,RaceNightElf,RaceUndead,RaceGnome,RaceTauren,RaceDwarf,RaceHighOrderSkyborne,RaceWindshaperSkyborne --output <scratch>/NAME-near, and --seed 20261007 --count 8 without --max-distance into <scratch>/NAME-far, for each of the nine bases; each variant <scratch>/NAME-near/sweep-XX.json is compared as variants/NAME-near-sweep-XX.request.json

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2
